solution.summary: The algorithm is successfully validated at a curved road with a junction for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars, where it achieves 25 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson ORIN for real-time applications.

I NTRODUCTION RGB (red, green, blue) cameras and 3D automotive radar sensors are widely used for precise road user detection and tracking in advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous vehicle development [1], [2].
Recently, with advancements in intelligent transportation systems (ITS), their deployment in roadside infrastructure setups has gained popularity for road user detection [3]-[6].

evidence.quote: The algorithm is successfully validated at a curved road with a junction for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars, where it achieves 25 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson ORIN for real-time applications.
